evidence.statement: The linked LC-PRIM-0003 interval belongs to a conserved Domain IV region involved in 50S/30S subunit association; U1940 within the primitive has direct mutational evidence for this role.
Codebook abstraction: SUBUNIT_DOCK — a conserved interface token participating in joining/stabilizing the two ribosomal subunits.

unknowns: Whether the full exact 16-mer acts as one indivisible functional unit.
